summary: Independent design review for TASK-0156 approves the frozen specification and allowed_scope. Digests in the design context (context_sha256, spec_sha256, policy_sha256, classification_input_sha256) match .ai/tasks/TASK-0156/ and .ai/policy/ exactly. Inspection of tools/analysis/ confirms exactly the 11 listed Python modules and zero runtime imports from tools/analysis/ anywhere in src/aiflow/; the 18 test files marked for deletion exclusively cover those retired modules. Repository-wide cross-checks across src/, tools/, tests/, .github/, .ai/, and pyproject.toml confirm no unaddressed coupling outside allowed_scope that would fail pytest, ruff, or mypy: all 5 core/CI/policy files (pyproject.toml, .github/workflows/ai-quality-gate.yml, tools/ci/check_coverage.py, src/aiflow/verification.py, .ai/policy/verification-levels.yaml), docs/operations/quickstart.md, and all 6 coupled test files (tests/unit/test_policy.py, tests/unit/test_verification_plan.py, tests/unit/test_check_coverage.py, tests/integration/test_coverage_gates.py, tests/integration/test_github_workflow.py, tests/integration/test_acceptance_traceability.py) are captured in allowed_scope, while existing entry-doc link checks remain intact with operational doc archival separated into a follow-up PR. Policy version 2.6.0, V0/V1/V2 prefix invariants, >= 85% total branch coverage, >= 90% diff coverage, and all authorization files (AGENTS.md, .ai/policy/hard-rules.yaml, .ai/policy/permissions.yaml, .ai/policy/routing.yaml, .ai/bootstrap-mode.yaml) are preserved intact.
